message.content: {"brief_rationale":"Despite many strong actions, the trajectory has a serious responsibility-chain omission: before surgery the doctor did not visibly screen for the required infection/urinary, cardiopulmonary, neurologic, and markedly abnormal blood-pressure red flags; only limited BP tracking and later postoperative safety-netting appear. Under the frozen rubric, any serious responsibility-chain error mandates grade 1 even if later logistics, medication boundaries, and closure are strong.
